# Fishing Frenzy Autonomous Player

Curated by Skill Harbor — turns your Muse into an autonomous Fishing Frenzy player: through 36 MCP tools from the fishing-frenzy server it fishes in batches, sells the catch, cooks, dives, completes quests, opens chests, climbs leaderboards and optimizes the in-game economy — making every gameplay decision itself, with a visual play-by-play display style and a CONFIG.md for your preferences (including staking targets). Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @unchartedgg.
